title: CS-44 Pedagogical Innovation Taxonomy v2
counting_unit: One distinct outline item (overview paragraph, learning outcome, assessment row, or weekly-schedule row) evaluated once per category.

policies.unit_category_total: Sum of item scores classified positive for the category; review scores are reported separately.

categories.name: Work-Integrated and Applied Learning
categories.definition: An educational approach that explicitly merges theory with real-world practice and embeds authentic industry, workplace, or community-relevant work and tasks into a unit of study.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Project- and Problem-Based Learning, Case-Based Learning, Community Learning, and Entrepreneurial Learning.
categories.review_guidance: Check that professional or partner language describes an authentic learning task rather than a generic context statement.

rules.label: industry or business partner
rules.pattern: industry partner|business partner|partner briefing|pitch to partner|partner's business|partner business

rules.label: actual organisation or professional context
rules.pattern: actual business organisation|actual business problem|actual business professionals

rules.label: authentic practice
rules.pattern: authentic situations|authentic problem|authentic industry|workplace project|industry project|consulting project|work-integrated learning

rules.label: theory-practice integration
rules.pattern: theory and practice|theory with real-world practice

categories.name: Simulation
categories.definition: An instructional method that recreates or mimics real-world scenarios, environments, or processes so learners can practise skills and make decisions safely.
categories.overlap_notes: Separated from Case-Based Learning by tutor revision. A real-world scenario alone is not a simulation unless the activity recreates, mimics, or role-plays a setting or process.
categories.review_guidance: Do not inherit Simulation from a case-study label or from Case-Based Learning evidence.

rules.label: explicit simulation
rules.pattern: business simulation|lab-based simulation|virtual simulation|simulation-based learning|simulated environment|simulated process

categories.name: Case-Based Learning
categories.definition: An active teaching method in which students use real-world scenarios and case studies to build critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning and Project- and Problem-Based Learning. Industry context does not exclude a case-based classification.
categories.review_guidance: An administrative assessment type such as 'Case studies' is retained as a weak review signal and is not sufficient by itself for a positive classification.

rules.label: explicit case method
rules.pattern: case study analysis|case study practice|case-based learning|case based learning

rules.label: case activity
rules.pattern: case-based exam|case based exam|case competition|case discussion

categories.name: Project- and Problem-Based Learning
categories.definition: Learning focused on real-world problems and challenges using problem-solving, decision-making, investigative, and self-directed learning skills.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning when projects involve clients or industry partners, and with Case-Based Learning when cases are used inside a project.
categories.review_guidance: Do not classify from the generic word 'project' alone; require a problem, challenge, immersion, investigation, or explicit project/problem-based method.

rules.label: explicit project or problem-based method
rules.pattern: project-based learning|project based learning|problem-based learning|problem based learning|challenge-based learning|challenge based learning

rules.label: authentic problem or challenge
rules.pattern: actual business problem|real-world problem|real world problem|complex challenge

rules.label: problem and opportunity scoping
rules.pattern: problem & opportunity scoping|problem and opportunity scoping

categories.name: Community Learning
categories.definition: Learning undertaken together with or for communities, including service-learning, field studies, and professional communities of practice.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning when the authentic partner is a community organisation.
categories.review_guidance: Require an explicit community, service-learning, field-study, or community-of-practice activity.

rules.label: community project or field study
rules.pattern: community project|social impact project|field study|field studies

categories.name: Entrepreneurial Learning
categories.definition: Learning that develops the knowledge, skills, and mindset to recognise opportunities, turn ideas into action, and manage new ventures under uncertainty.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Project- and Problem-Based Learning and Simulation when learners develop or simulate a venture.
categories.review_guidance: Generic ideation, pitching, or prototyping is a review signal unless explicitly connected to entrepreneurship, a startup, a product-development project, or a venture.

rules.label: product development project
rules.pattern: product development project|startup pitch|start-up pitch|pitch competition

categories.name: Technology-Mediated Learning
categories.definition: An instructional environment in which digital devices, networks, or specialised technologies mediate access to content and interaction during learning.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Simulation, Hybrid Learning, or Entrepreneurial Learning. Merely studying digital technology is not evidence that learning is technology-mediated.
categories.review_guidance: Require the technology to be part of the learning method, not only the subject matter.

rules.label: immersive or virtual learning
rules.pattern: vr-based experiential learning|vr based experiential learning|ar-based experiential learning|ar based experiential learning|virtual simulation

rules.label: AI-mediated or digital twin
rules.pattern: ai-mediated role-play|ai mediated role play|digital twin exercise|digital twin exercises

rules.label: immersive scenario training
rules.pattern: immersive scenario training|technology-mediated learning|technology mediated learning

categories.name: Hybrid Learning
categories.definition: An education model that mixes face-to-face classroom teaching with online digital instruction.
categories.overlap_notes: May overlap with Technology-Mediated Learning, but requires an explicit combination of physical and online modes.
categories.review_guidance: Online materials alone are insufficient; require an explicit hybrid, blended, flipped, hyflex, or mixed-mode design.

rules.label: mixed face-to-face and online
rules.pattern: face-to-face and online|face to face and online|mixed-mode learning|mixed mode learning

rules.label: self-paced online modules
rules.pattern: self-paced online module|self paced online module|self-paced modules
